notes:
Tasks: swipe any open task — in Total, Not Accepted Yet, Overdue, In Progress and the rest — to change its status; where there is no quick move, the swipe opens the status menu. You can ask for more time as often as you need once you have accepted a task, and on a task you set for yourself it is granted straight away. The task page now shows the time it was assigned, and every comment shows the time it was added. All reminder options are back: App or Email, Before, After or Repeat until done. A recurring task can now be deleted.

My Interviews is redesigned: it opens on your next interview, with the candidate, the call and the résumé at the top, what the earlier rounds said below, and your assessment as clear numbered steps with a checklist. A round can be marked No Show, and rescheduled to a new date. A résumé can now be a photo (JPG or PNG) as well as a PDF or Word file, and opens as one.

For the CEO and MD: Go To on Home is now a small button, and the day's interviews, tasks and everything else are always shown below it.

My Cashbook is redesigned: your balance and Ask for an advance sit side by side at the top, and a book can now be deleted from its ⋯ menu — nothing in it is lost, every entry stays on your wallet. When you record an expense, the date sits inside the amount box. The PDF button on a book now opens the Day-wise with category summary straight away.
